roomId.description: The sealed room to renew. The recipient MUST hold its group.

host.description: The room's host, as a DID: where the room's epoch advances.

reason.description: Why, carried to the host's epoch advance. Untrusted and attributed to its author: it MUST NOT carry personal data or a credential.

Response.title: Rooms Owner Group Renew — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/owner/group/renew. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/owner/group/renew/0.1#response. The room's new epoch, at which the host and the group agree.

epoch.description: The room epoch after the renewal, as the host recorded it.
